scope: Approved 017 backend dispatch, protected execution and canonical transaction fencing

red.reason: Owner resume and protected execution package methods were absent before implementation

scenarios.name: Same blocked job owner-only CAS resume and immutable package audit
Scoped resume replay, request conflict, stale generation and active attempt rejection
Lost claim response and stale host recovery freeze verification without lease reset or resend
Actual transaction fence rejects changed generation, task status, hold, handoff and inactive channel before writes
Protected execution integration, canonical lease binding, trusted evidence and mandatory media acknowledgement
Existing dispatch and strict package compatibility
Advanced package invalidation or package hash change preserves replacement heartbeat, freezes same job and retains attempt/lease evidence

errors_resolved: Intermediate backend integration type errors while parallel worker and service contracts were being aligned
Advanced-state package snapshot error escaped heartbeat transaction; recognized invalidation now freezes verification-required state
controls: Caller evidence cannot grant trusted reconciliation provenance
Media acknowledgement requires private trusted verification
